title: How fast is each animal?
prompt: Place each animal from slowest to fastest.

items.label: A garden snail
items.fact: A snail would need most of a day to cross a single soccer field.

items.label: A giant tortoise
items.fact: Even ambling, a tortoise moves about eight times faster than a snail.

items.label: A jogging human
items.fact: A steady jog is roughly 10 km/h — a 6-minute kilometer.

items.label: A greyhound
items.fact: The fastest dog breed, built like a sprinter.

items.label: A cheetah
items.fact: The fastest land animal — but only in bursts of a few seconds.

items.label: A diving peregrine falcon
items.fact: In a hunting stoop, the peregrine is the fastest animal on Earth.
